name: Plex Bridge
description: Browse and stream remote Plex movie and TV libraries through Jellyfin without exposing Plex credentials to clients.
overview: Remote Plex libraries as a Jellyfin Channel

versions.changelog:
- Rename the channel root to `Plex Libraries`.
- Add multiple configured Plex servers beneath the channel root.
- Scope library browsing, metadata, caches, artwork proxying, media IDs, and signed playback URLs to the selected server.
- Preserve the previous single-server configuration as a migration fallback.
- Add optional per-server Plex playback timeline reporting.

- Map Plex elementary video, audio, and embedded subtitle metadata into Jellyfin `MediaStream` entries.
- Add conservative fallback video/audio descriptors when Plex omits detailed stream metadata.
- Log upstream Plex HTTP status, range, content type, and content length for media proxy requests.
- Bump the Channel data version so stale media metadata is refreshed.
